name: organiser-style-v1
description: The 17 synthesised cases re-expressed in the organisers' sample-dataset shape, plus the organisers' own sample case(s) verbatim.
provenance: Organiser samples (DISP-*) are copied unmodified from the file the organisers shared. Every other case is synthetic, generated from ryde-synth-v1 by tools/organiser_pack.py: same numbers, organiser field names, model-drafted free-text descriptions reviewed by the team.
schema_extensions: trip_data carries our route-deviation fields (estimated_distance_km, estimated_duration_min, pickup_time, dropoff_time, fare): the organiser sample is a no-show and has no slot for them.
ryde_extensions carries the claim amount, intake-form answers and rider_claims_driver_absent, which the organiser ticket has no slot for.
cancellation_policy on synthetic cases carries Ryde's published terms (the docs/policy.md parameters); on organiser samples it carries the organisers' own terms and governs that case.
